correctness.rationale: All six length-thirteen factors are checked to have exactly the eight listed circular occurrences in the independently reconstructed Lyndon order-sixteen de Bruijn word. Every length-sixteen word occurs uniquely. A 4096-set must intersect 65536 unique windows with exactly 4096*16 incidences, forcing all adjacent gaps to equal sixteen; hence only sixteen residue classes. The six forbidden-residue masks cover those classes. Earlier dyadic cases are exhaustively checked. The lower bound is 4097, with exact optimum explicitly unproved.

value.rationale: This tests a natural open structural distinction emphasized in the literature between equidistant sharp-order coverage and full-factor attraction for composite-order Lyndon de Bruijn words. The canonical dyadic series 1,2,4,8,16 first loses lower-bound attainment at order sixteen. A compact six-factor witness isolates why, giving a substantive finite boundary/counterexample while making no exaggerated claim of a full optimum or general asymptotic theorem.
